Rains lash Tamil Nadu; schools closed in many districts on October 23
 Villupuram, Kallakurichi, Vellore, Puducherry, and Karaikal districts have declared holidays for school due to rain
 Updated - October 23, 2026 11:44 am IST 
 The Hindu Bureau Subscribe to The Hindu @ Just ₹1* Subscribe to The Hindu @ Just $4.99 *Offer only for new subscribers 
 School students are back home after a declared holiday due to rain in Vellore on October 23, 2026.
 | Photo Credit: C. Venkatachalapathy
 Heavy rain from the active northeast monsoon lashed Tamil Nadu, forcing several districts to declare a holiday for schools on Friday (October 23, 2026).
 Advertisement Advertisement Villupuram, Kallakurichi, Vellore, Puducherry, and Karaikal districts were among those that witnessed heavy rain, which led authorities to declare holidays for schools on Friday (October 23, 2026).
 The IMD predicted moderate to heavy rainfall across Tamil Nadu and Puducherry until October 26. Heavy rain is anticipated in Tiruvallur, Villuppuram, Tiruchirappalli, Erode, Ariyalur, Perambalur, Cuddalore, Namakkal, Tiruppur, and Karur districts. General moderate rainfall is expected over the next two days in Chennai and its neighbourhood, with potential for heavy downpour on October 24 and 25.
 The Regional Meteorological Centre Chennai has issued an Orange Alert on its website for heavy rain.
